metadata.title: Kavach — scam help for India
metadata.description: Got scammed or received a suspicious call, message or payment request? Get step-by-step help, check numbers and UPI IDs, and report scams.

home.title: Scammed, or got a suspicious message?
home.subtitle: Free help for people in India. No sign-in needed.
home.scammedHint: Step-by-step help for the first hour
home.checkTitle: Check a number, UPI ID or link
home.checkHint: See if others reported it as a scam.
home.analyseHint: Paste an SMS, WhatsApp or email message.
home.analyseNotice: Messages are checked by an AI service. Never paste OTPs, PINs or passwords.
home.reportButton: Report a scam and get complaint text

auth.title: Sign in to Kavach
auth.subtitle: Sign in to save your report, track its status and download your complaint.
auth.codeSentTo: We sent a 6-digit code to {email}. It expires in 10 minutes.
auth.neverShare: Kavach will never call you or ask for this code. Anyone who asks for it is a scammer.

errors.invalidCode: Enter the 6-digit code from the email.
errors.wrongCode: That code is wrong or has expired. Check the latest email or ask for a new code.
errors.tooManyAttempts: Too many attempts. Please wait a minute and try again.
errors.oauthFailed: Google sign-in did not complete. Please try again or use email.
errors.serviceUnavailable: We can't reach our sign-in service right now. Please try again in a moment.
errors.botCheckFailed: We couldn't confirm you're not a bot. Please wait a moment and try again.

dashboard.title: My reports
dashboard.empty: You have not saved any reports yet.
dashboard.intro: Your reports are private. Only you can see them.
dashboard.exportBody: Get a copy of everything you've given Kavach as a file. Links to your evidence files inside it work for 15 minutes.
dashboard.deleteBody: This permanently deletes your account, all your reports and evidence files. Scammer details you reported stop counting toward public warnings. This can't be undone.
dashboard.deleteFailed: We couldn't delete your data right now. Please try again.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.body: This page does not exist. If you need help with a scam, start from the home page.

items.1: Pressure or threats: “your account will be blocked today”, “arrest warrant in your name”.
items.2: Asking for an OTP, UPI PIN, CVV, password or screen sharing.
items.3: Asking you to pay first to get money, a prize, a refund, a loan or a job.
items.4: Links that look like a bank, courier or government site but have a strange address.
items.5: “Police” or “CBI” keeping you on a video call (“digital arrest”). This does not exist — hang up.
items.6: Profits that are too good to be true, or tasks that pay you to like videos.

emergency.title: Scammed? Do these steps now
emergency.intro: Stay calm. Acting in the first hour gives the best chance of stopping your money. Do these in order and tick each one off.
emergency.hangUpTitle: Is someone still on a call with you?
emergency.hangUpBody: Hang up now. Real police, banks and government officers never ask for money, OTPs or screen sharing on a call.
emergency.notYourFault: This is not your fault. Scammers are professionals who fool thousands of careful people every day.

call1930.title: Call 1930, the national cyber fraud helpline
call1930.body: Call right away if money has left your account. The sooner you call, the better the chance your money can be frozen before scammers move it.
call1930.listTitle: Keep this ready when you call:

items.1: Your bank name and account number or UPI ID
items.2: Transaction ID (UTR), date, time and amount
items.3: The scammer's phone number, UPI ID or website link

call1930.note: If 1930 is busy, keep trying, and file online (next step) at the same time.

portal.title: File a complaint on cybercrime.gov.in
portal.body: On the National Cyber Crime Reporting Portal, choose “Report Cyber Crime”, then the financial fraud option. Save the acknowledgement number you get. Your bank and the police will ask for it.

bank.title: Call your bank to block and dispute
bank.body: Ask them to block your card, UPI and net banking if you shared any details, and to raise a fraud dispute for the payment. Write down the complaint reference number.
bank.note: Only use the number on the back of your card or in your bank's official app. Never call a “customer care” number from a Google search, SMS or WhatsApp.
bank.extra: RBI rules protect you best when you tell your bank about an unauthorised transaction quickly, within 3 working days.

chakshu.title: Report the fraud call or message on Sanchar Saathi
chakshu.body: On the Sanchar Saathi website or app, choose “Chakshu: Report Suspected Fraud Communication” and enter the number and message. This helps get scam numbers blocked.

evidence.title: Save all evidence
evidence.body: Take screenshots before you block anyone or delete anything:

items.1: Chats, SMS and emails from the scammer
items.3: Payment screens, bank SMS and transaction IDs (UTR)
items.4: Their profile, website link or app name

evidence.note: Don't delete the chats, even if you feel embarrassed.

items.1: Uninstall any screen-sharing app the caller asked you to install (like AnyDesk or TeamViewer).
items.2: Change your UPI PIN, net banking and email passwords, using a phone the scammer never had access to.
items.3: If your SIM suddenly stopped working, call your mobile operator at once. It may be a SIM swap.

recovery.title: Don't pay anyone who promises to get your money back
recovery.body: “Recovery agents”, “cyber lawyers” or “officers” who ask for a fee to return your money are running a second scam. 1930, the police and banks never charge you to recover money.

emergency.nextBody: Report the scam to get complaint text for the police and your bank, and to warn others. You can also check if others reported the same number.

check.metaTitle: Check a number, UPI ID or link
check.title: Check a number, UPI ID or link
check.intro: See if other people have reported a phone number, UPI ID, website or email as a scam.
check.label: Phone number, UPI ID, link or email
check.examples: You can paste a phone number, UPI ID, UPI QR link, website, WhatsApp link (wa.me) or email.

errors.empty: Type or paste a phone number, UPI ID, link or email.
errors.unrecognized: We couldn't recognise that. Enter a phone number, a UPI ID (like name@ybl), a website link or an email.
errors.too_long: That's too long. Paste just the number, UPI ID or link.
errors.ip_address: Links that use a bare IP address (like 192.168.1.1) can't be checked. Treat them as very suspicious.
errors.unsupported_scheme: Only website links (starting with http or https) can be checked.
errors.invalid: That link doesn't look right. Check it and try again.
errors.unavailable: We couldn't check right now. Please try again in a moment. If you've lost money, don't wait: call 1930.
errors.rateLimited: Too many checks in a short time. Please wait a minute and try again.

check.reportedTitle: Reported as a scam by {count, plural, one {# person} other {# people}}
check.notVerified: Reported by Kavach users. Not verified by Kavach or the police.
check.reportedAdvice: Don't pay, share an OTP or install any app they ask for. If you've already paid, follow the emergency steps now.
check.notReportedBody: Not enough people have reported this yet. That does not mean it is safe: scammers change numbers and links often.
check.notReportedAdvice: Never share an OTP, UPI PIN or card details, and never pay to “receive” money.
check.sharedPlatform: {host} is a big platform used by millions of people, so we only check this exact link, not the whole site.
check.lookalike: Warning: this address uses look-alike characters ({host}). Scammers use these to imitate real brand websites.
check.whatsappFound: This WhatsApp link opens a chat with {phone}.
check.telegramFound: This Telegram link opens the account {handle}.
check.similarHint: Scam sites often differ from real ones by a letter or two.
check.emergencyCta: I've lost money. What do I do?
check.disclaimer: Kavach shows what users have reported to help people stay safe. Reports are not verified and are not proof that anyone committed a crime.
check.reportCtaHint: Were you contacted from this? Report it so others are warned.

analyse.title: Is this message a scam?
analyse.intro: Paste a suspicious SMS, WhatsApp or email message, or share a screenshot. Our AI checks it for common scam signs.
analyse.aiNotice: Messages are checked by an AI service (Google Gemini). We remove your own details first, but never paste OTPs, PINs or passwords.
analyse.checking: Checking… this can take up to 20 seconds
analyse.imageWarning: We can't remove personal details from a picture. If you can, crop out your name, number and account details first.
analyse.imageNotice: The screenshot is sent to an AI service (Google Gemini) only when you tap the button below.

result.lowNote: This doesn't mean it's safe. When in doubt, don't pay, don't share OTPs, and contact the bank or company on their official number.
result.riskRaised: Marked “very likely a scam” because a number or link in it has been reported by other Kavach users.
result.reportedBy: {count, plural, one {Reported by # person} other {Reported by # people}}
result.lookupFailed: We couldn't check these against Kavach reports right now.
result.reportHint: Did you get this message? Report it to get complaint text for the police and your bank, and to warn others.
result.sentTitle: What we sent to the AI
result.aiDisclaimer: This is an automated check and can be wrong. It is not legal advice.

errors.invalidInput: Please paste a message or choose a screenshot.
errors.tooShort: Paste a bit more of the message (at least 10 characters).
errors.tooLong: That's too long. Paste up to 5,000 characters.
errors.invalidImage: That image couldn't be read. Try a JPG or PNG screenshot.
errors.aiNotConfigured: The AI checker isn't available right now. You can still check numbers and links, or follow the emergency steps.
errors.aiBusy: The AI checker is busy right now. Please try again in a minute.
errors.aiUnavailable: We couldn't reach the AI service. Please try again in a moment.
errors.aiBlocked: The AI service couldn't analyse this. Use the warning signs below to judge it, or check the numbers and links in it.
errors.aiBadResponse: The AI gave an answer we couldn't read. Please try again.
errors.aiRateLimited: You've checked a lot of messages in a short time. Please wait a few minutes and try again.
errors.botCheckFailed: We couldn't confirm you're not a bot. Please wait a moment and try again.

report.title: Report a scam
report.intro: Takes about 5 minutes. Your answers are saved on this phone until you submit.
report.draftRestored: We restored the answers you saved earlier.

what.title: What happened?
what.categoryLabel: What kind of scam was it?
what.descriptionHint: Who contacted you, what they said and what you did. Don't write OTPs, PINs or passwords.

identifiers.title: The scammer's details
identifiers.hint: Add the phone number, UPI ID, link, email or account they used. This is what warns other people.
identifiers.empty: No details added yet. You can still continue.

money.title: Money and date
money.last4Label: Last 4 digits of YOUR bank account (optional)
money.last4Hint: Only the last 4 digits. Never type your full account number.
money.txnHint: You'll find it in your bank SMS or in the UPI app's payment history.

evidence.title: Evidence
evidence.hint: Add screenshots, call recordings or documents. Up to 10 files, 10 MB each.
evidence.tooMany: You can add up to 10 files.
evidence.privateNote: Files are private: only you can see them. They are uploaded only after you submit.
evidence.empty: No files added. You can add them later too.

consent.title: Your consent
consent.purpose1: We store your report privately. Only you can see it.
consent.purpose2: The scammer's details (phone number, UPI ID, links) go into a shared database. When 2 or more people report the same detail, others can see that it was reported. Your name, email and files are never shown.
consent.purpose3: We turn your report into complaint text you can file with the police and your bank. We don't file anything for you.
consent.purpose4: You can download or delete all your data at any time from “My reports”.
consent.checkbox: I agree to Kavach storing and using my report for these purposes.

review.title: Check and submit
review.removedWarning: For your safety, we'll remove these from your description before saving: {items}.
review.signInHint: Sign in with your email so you can come back to your report later. Your answers stay saved on this phone.

errors.invalidIdentifier: This doesn't look right for the type you chose. Check it and try again.
errors.invalidDate: Enter a date that isn't in the future.
errors.consentRequired: Please tick the box to continue.
errors.rateLimited: You've sent a lot of reports today. Please try again tomorrow.
errors.serviceUnavailable: We couldn't save your report right now. Your answers are still saved on this phone. Please try again.
errors.uploadFailed: Some files couldn't be uploaded. You can add them again from your report page.
errors.storageUnavailable: File uploads aren't available right now. Your report is saved; try adding files later.
errors.botCheckFailed: We couldn't confirm you're not a bot. Please wait a moment and tap Submit again.

reportPage.title: Your report
reportPage.newBanner: Your report is saved. Now file your complaint using the text below.
reportPage.uploadIssue: Some files couldn't be uploaded. Add them again below.
reportPage.notFiling: Kavach doesn't send anything to the police or your bank. You file the complaint yourself, using the text below.
reportPage.call1930: Call 1930 and give them these details
reportPage.portalHint: Paste this into the incident details box when you file your complaint.
reportPage.bankHint: Email it from your registered email address, or print it and take it to your branch. Fill in the parts in [brackets].
reportPage.hashHint: This fingerprint proves the file hasn't changed since you uploaded it.
reportPage.uploadDone: {count, plural, one {# file uploaded} other {# files uploaded}}.
reportPage.pdfNote: The PDF is in English, for police and bank officials.
reportPage.pdfFailed: We couldn't create the PDF. Please try again.
reportPage.deleteBody: This permanently deletes the report and its files. It can't be undone.

flag.title: Why should a moderator look at this?

reasons.my_identifier: This is my number or ID

flag.thanks: Thanks. A moderator will review this entry.

errors.invalid: Something was wrong with the form. Please try again.
errors.rateLimited: You've sent many flags recently. Please try again later.
errors.botCheckFailed: We couldn't confirm you're not a bot. Please wait a moment and try again.
errors.unavailable: We couldn't send this right now. Please try again in a moment.

admin.title: Moderation
admin.intro: Review flagged entries, hide abusive ones and merge duplicates. Reporters' identities are never shown.
admin.queueEmpty: No open flags. All caught up.
admin.visibleHint: Shown in public lookup once 2 or more people have reported it.
admin.hiddenHint: Hidden: public lookup says "no reports" for this entry.
admin.mergeHint: Merge this entry into the correct one. Its reports move there, and lookups of this value show the correct entry.

errors.invalid: Check the form and try again.
errors.invalidTarget: That value isn't valid for the chosen type.
errors.targetNotFound: No entry with that value exists.

offline.banner: You're offline. The emergency steps still work.

errorPage.title: Something went wrong
errorPage.body: Sorry, this page didn't load properly. If you've lost money, don't wait: call 1930 now.
